title: Pacific Pinball Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: s to PPM are valid all day long with ins-and-outs, so you're welcome to take a break and visit the many shops and restaurants in the neighborhood. We ask that you don't bring food or drink inside the museum, but water bottles and coffee cups with lids are permitted. In addition to our over 100 playable machines and exhibits, we have jukeboxes, self-guided tours, and activity sheets for you to enjoy. We have a water cooler available, as well as gender-neutral single-occupancy restrooms, and sitting areas throughout the museum.
